summary: JFB Construction Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that a written consent from majority stockholders (Joseph F. Basile, III and The Basile Family Irrevocable Trust) was delivered, satisfying the stockholder approval condition for its merger with Xtend AI Robotics (Newco) and XTEND Reality Expansion. The merger is expected to close mid-2026 under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated February 13, 2026, as amended March 21, 2026. No financial terms or advisors were mentioned. The filing removes restrictions on stockholder written consent in the bylaws. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb spread may narrow as a key condition is now met.
